explication: DeepAudit is a web-based AI security-auditing product. The documented user journey is to manage or import a project, launch an Agent audit, follow its live execution, inspect findings, and export a report; the product also supports instant code analysis, rules, prompts, and project dashboards. The graph combines those documented capabilities with source-index relationships and excerpts. Several central implementations were not sampled, so uncertain runtime links are omitted or marked unverified.
